title: If Eleanor Rigby Had Met ChatGPT: A Study on Loneliness in a Post-LLM World

bias_targets.methodology: Automated labeling of user-chatbot dialogue transcripts using GPT-4o to classify the demographic target of toxic, harmful, or sexual content (Women vs. Men) and explicitly tracking instances of sexism.
